# Bundled QR encoder

`segno-1.6.6-py3-none-any.whl` is the unmodified Segno 1.6.6 wheel from PyPI:

- Source: https://pypi.org/project/segno/1.6.6/
- SHA-256: `28c7d081ed0cf935e0411293a465efd4d500704072cdb039778a2ab8736190c7`
- License: BSD-3-Clause; the original license is included in the wheel and in `LICENSE.segno`.

The CLI imports this bundled wheel for offline PNG encoding. It does not run pip or send verification links to a QR service. The installer verifies both the wheel and the license against pinned checksums.
